selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall, globally allowed SSH, node2-only TCP/9000, and catch-all rejection
selected_evidence.summary: Runtime and permanent rules match after reboot; firewalld is active/enabled, SSH is allowed, node2 received HTTP 200, and node3 was rejected. Explicit catch-all IPv4 and IPv6 reject rules cover every other source.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from 6bb7e004… to 35e1f23f…, and recovered firewall, SSH, configuration checksum, and listeners.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from 437b338f… to 196557c7…, unchanged persistent machine identity, active SSH/networking, and restored authorized TCP/9000 access.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID change from fbdf5b2c… to 5e040b07…, unchanged persistent machine identity, active SSH/networking, and continued rejection from TCP/9000.
